arnestyles.gui.title: Arne Tweaks
arnestyles.gui.pending: Changes are applied when you close this menu
arnestyles.update.title: ArneTweaks %s is out!
arnestyles.update.toast: Download it on GitHub (link in chat)
arnestyles.cloud.failed: Download failed - check your internet, F5 to retry
arnestyles.gui.empty: No custom styles yet. Click "Open folder" above and add a style folder to styles/%s. Then press F5.
arnestyles.gui.essentials_info: Click = on/off, drag sliders, right-click = reset
arnestyles.gui.hint: ↑↓ category | ←→ style | Enter on/off | F5 reload | Del 2x reset
arnestyles.gui.reset_confirm: Press Del again to reset the configuration. Any other key cancels.
arnestyles.essential.low_fire.desc: Fire in front of your eyes lower and smaller. Depth below with -/+
arnestyles.essential.no_explosion_partic: No explosion clouds from crystals, anchors and TNT
No frame while wearing a carved pumpkin
arnestyles.essential.no_fog.desc: No fog in water, lava, powder snow and in the distance, and no overlay under water. Blindness stays
arnestyles.essential.small_gap.desc: Golden apples smaller in your hand and while eating
arnestyles.essential.small_items.desc: Pearls, potions, food, buckets, rockets etc. smaller in your hand
arnestyles.essential.low_shield.desc: Shield sits lower and covers less, also while blocking
arnestyles.essential.obvious_powder_snow: Powder snow gets a red border so you spot it instantly
arnestyles.essential.no_smoke.desc: No smoke from fire, torches, campfires and lava
arnestyles.essential.fullbright.desc: Everything bright, even in caves and at night
arnestyles.slider.totem_pop_size.desc: Size of the totem animation on screen (0% = off)
arnestyles.slider.totem_particles.desc: Amount of particles on a totem pop (0% = none)
arnestyles.slider.held_item_size.desc: All items in your hand bigger or smaller (100% = normal)
arnestyles.slider.low_fire_depth.desc: How low and small the fire is when Low Fire is on
arnestyles.gui.mod_disabled: ArneTweaks is off. Minecraft looks completely normal.
arnestyles.gui.sky_hint: Custom skies also need the Skyboxify mod
arnestyles.gui.presets_info: Save your current setup under a name or load a preset
arnestyles.gui.presets_empty: No presets yet. Type a name and click Save.
arnestyles.gui.preset_loaded: Preset "%s" loaded, applied when you close the menu
arnestyles.gui.preset_error: That did not work, see the log
arnestyles.gui.mods_info: Extra features. Hover over an entry for more info.
arnestyles.gui.sort_hint: Sorting: move entries with the arrows, the button next to search ends it
arnestyles.slider.pack_sound_volume.desc: Volume of all sounds from built-in packs, 0 to 200%
arnestyles.mod.pop_chams.desc: Colored ghost where a player pops a totem
arnestyles.mod.pop_chams_own.desc: Also show a ghost when you pop a totem yourself
arnestyles.mod.pop_chams_fade.desc: The ghost slowly fades instead of disappearing at once
arnestyles.mod.pop_chams_disperse.desc: Head, body, arms and legs fly outwards
arnestyles.mod.pop_chams_lifetime.desc: How long the ghost stays visible
arnestyles.mod.pop_chams_color.desc: Color of the ghost, click a color
arnestyles.mod.shield_fix.desc: Other players reliably show as blocking when their shield is up (MC-238293)
arnestyles.mod.shield_fix_delay.desc: Only show blocking once the shield really blocks (after 5 ticks)
arnestyles.mod.shield_sounds.desc: Instant shield sound when you hit a blocking player. Only for servers without own sounds
arnestyles.essential.no_darkness.desc: No darkness effect from the Warden and sculk shriekers, you keep seeing normally
arnestyles.gui.mod_blocked.desc: The mod "%s" is installed. To avoid doubles the built-in version stays off. Remove that mod to use this one
arnestyles.mod.shield_status.desc: Shield green when it can block, red when an axe disabled it
arnestyles.mod.shield_status_others.desc: Uses the shield break sound to see when an enemy's shield is disabled (5 seconds)
arnestyles.mod.shield_status_fade.desc: Red slowly turns green, so you see when the shield works again
arnestyles.mod.totem_counter.desc: Shows after the name how many totems a player popped (e.g. -3). Resets on death
arnestyles.mod.totem_counter_hud.desc: Totem icon above the hotbar with the number of totems in your inventory
arnestyles.mod.armor_hud.desc: Your armor with durability bars, a red ! blinks when it is almost broken
arnestyles.mod.armor_hud_right.desc: Show the armor on the right side of the hotbar
arnestyles.mod.armor_hud_percent.desc: Remaining durability in percent above each armor piece
arnestyles.mod.effect_timer.desc: Remaining time directly on the effect icons in the top right
arnestyles.mod.effect_timer_level.desc: Effect level (II, III, ...) in the top right of the icon
arnestyles.mod.inventory_scale.desc: Inventory and chests bigger or smaller, independent of GUI scale (1.00x = normal)
arnestyles.mod.appleskin_saturation.desc: Yellow outline over the hunger icons shows your hidden saturation
arnestyles.mod.appleskin_preview.desc: While holding food, the hunger and saturation it gives blink on the hunger bar
arnestyles.mod.appleskin_health.desc: While holding food, the hearts it will heal blink on the health bar (estimate)
arnestyles.mod.appleskin_tooltip.desc: Hunger and saturation of food in the item tooltip
arnestyles.mod.motion_blur.desc: Blends frames together so fast movements smear. Only the world, not the HUD. Not with Iris shaders
arnestyles.mod.motion_blur_strength.desc: How much of the previous frame stays visible (same feel at any FPS)
arnestyles.mod.no_chat_restrictions.desc: Chat, multiplayer and Realms work even if your account settings disable them. Bans still apply
arnestyles.gui.shaders_info: Work without Iris. "Open folder" for your own
arnestyles.gui.shaders_none: No Iris pack from this folder selected
arnestyles.gui.shaders_empty: No .zip shader packs in the folder yet
arnestyles.gui.shaders_no_iris.desc: Normal shader packs (.zip) need the Iris mod. ArneTweaks shaders above work without it
arnestyles.gui.shaders_hint_1: Note: these are image effects (colors, contrast, glow).
arnestyles.gui.shaders_hint_2: No shadows, water reflections or lighting like BSL.
arnestyles.gui.shaders_hint.desc: For real shadows and water you need Iris and a shader pack like BSL (section below)
arnestyles.tint.on.desc: Recolors the selected style (Default = Minecraft). Applied when you close the menu
arnestyles.tint.on.desc_stone: Recolors the selected style (Default = Bauloo Privat). Applied when you close the menu
arnestyles.tint.hue.desc: Click or drag in the color spectrum. Right click resets
arnestyles.tint.saturation.desc: How strong the color is (0% = gray)
arnestyles.tint.brightness.desc: How light or dark the texture becomes
arnestyles.mod.borderless_fullscreen.des: Fullscreen (F11) as a borderless window: Alt+Tab without flicker. Takes effect on the next F11
arnestyles.mod.hud_editor.desc: Move and resize the armor display and totem counter
arnestyles.mod.hud_editor.no_world: The HUD editor only works in a world (join a world or server first)
arnestyles.hud.title: Edit HUD
arnestyles.hud.help: Drag = move   Mouse wheel = size   Right click = reset
arnestyles.hud.none: Armor HUD and TotemCounter are off (Mods page), nothing to move
arnestyles.customize.info: Texture: %s - click a tile, pick a color in the wheel
arnestyles.customize.empty: This style has no textures to color
arnestyles.customize.own.desc: Only this texture of this style. Goes before the category color
arnestyles.customize.shift.desc: Off: texture gets one color. On: all colors are rotated together (wheel angle), good for totems or potions
arnestyles.tint.ore_spots.desc: Only the ore pieces get the color, the stone around them stays
arnestyles.tint.ore_follow.desc: The stone around the ores gets the custom color of Stone/Deepslate, so ores do not stand out
arnestyles.theme.info: Colors and size of this menu. Your designs are shareable files.
arnestyles.theme.scale.desc: How big the ArneTweaks menu is (100 % = normal). Applied when you let go.
arnestyles.theme.scale.release: Let go to apply the new size
arnestyles.theme.new.desc: Copies the current design as your own. Then you can change every color.
arnestyles.theme.builtin_hint: "%s" is a built-in design and can't be changed. Make a copy to set every color yourself:
arnestyles.theme.name.desc: Design name: just type, backspace deletes
arnestyles.theme.wheel.desc: Color wheel: angle = hue, distance from center = saturation
arnestyles.theme.brightness.desc: Brightness of the selected color. Right-click resets it.
arnestyles.theme.slot.backdrop.desc: Dimming behind the menu (the game shows through)
arnestyles.theme.slot.panel.desc: Base color of the menu window
arnestyles.theme.slot.sidebar.desc: Background of the list on the left
arnestyles.theme.slot.field.desc: Search box, input fields and preview areas
arnestyles.theme.slot.card_hover.desc: Cards, rows and buttons under the mouse
arnestyles.import.info: Whole texture packs are sorted into the right categories automatically.
arnestyles.import.drop: Just drag packs (.zip or folder) into this window
arnestyles.import.drop2: or put them in the import folder ("Open folder")
arnestyles.import.drop.desc: Every file goes into its category (totems, swords, ores, ...). Files that fit nowhere are left out.
arnestyles.import.chip: %s files in %s. Click to show and select.
arnestyles.import.empty: No packs yet. Drag a .zip or pack folder into the window, or put it in the import folder ("Open folder" at the top).
arnestyles.customize.states: %s (%s states, the color applies to all)
arnestyles.mod.keystrokes.desc: Shows W, A, S, D, mouse buttons and space. Pressed keys light up.
arnestyles.mod.keystrokes_cps.desc: Clicks per second right in the keystrokes under LMB and RMB
arnestyles.mod.cps_hud.desc: Clicks per second left | right and your maximum, as its own display
arnestyles.mod.ping_hud.desc: Your connection to the server in milliseconds
arnestyles.mod.coords_hud.desc: X / Y / Z and the direction you face
arnestyles.mod.combo_hud.desc: Hits in a row. Ends when you get hit or hit nothing for 3 seconds.
arnestyles.mod.pearl_cooldown.desc: Bar under the crosshair until you can throw a pearl again
arnestyles.mod.armor_warning.desc: Blinks above the crosshair when an armor piece is below 10 % durability
arnestyles.mod.armor_warning_sound.desc: A short bell as soon as an armor piece is almost broken
arnestyles.mod.target_hud.desc: Name, health, armor and items of your opponent. Note: not allowed on some servers.
arnestyles.hud.armor_low.head: Helmet almost broken!
arnestyles.mod.hit_color.desc: Hit players and mobs flash in your color instead of red. Only you see it.
arnestyles.mod.hit_color_pick.desc: Hit players and mobs flash in this color
arnestyles.mod.player_fire.desc: Moves the fire on burning players down so you can see them better (0 % = normal)
arnestyles.mod.crystal_size.desc: How big end crystals look. The hitbox stays the same.
arnestyles.mod.crystal_speed.desc: How fast end crystals spin (0 % = still)
arnestyles.mod.crystal_bounce.desc: Off: end crystals float calmly at one height
arnestyles.mod.kill_effects.desc: When someone dies that you hit in the last 5 seconds. Only you see it.
arnestyles.mod.kill_only_players.desc: Kill effects only for players, not mobs
arnestyles.mod.kill_lightning.desc: A lightning bolt with thunder (no damage, visual only)
arnestyles.mod.kill_firework.desc: A firework burst above the opponent
arnestyles.mod.totem_pop_sound.desc: Which sound plays on a totem pop. Normal = Minecraft or your sound style. Switch with < and >, click the name to listen.
arnestyles.mod.totem_pop_volume.desc: How loud the totem pop is (0 % = mute)
arnestyles.mod.block_outline.desc: The line around the block you look at, in your color and thickness
arnestyles.mod.outline_color.desc: Color of the line around the block you look at
arnestyles.mod.outline_rainbow.desc: The outline slowly cycles through all colors
arnestyles.mod.outline_width.desc: How thick the line is (1x = normal)
arnestyles.mod.custom_time.desc: Always the same time of day, only for you. The server doesn't notice.
arnestyles.mod.custom_time_value.desc: Which time of day you see (12:00 = noon, 18:30 = sunset, 00:00 = midnight)
arnestyles.mod.sky_color.desc: The overworld sky in your color
arnestyles.mod.sky_color_pick.desc: You see the sky in this color
arnestyles.mod.item_physics.desc: Dropped items lie flat on the ground instead of floating and spinning
arnestyles.gui.preset_copied: Code of "%s" copied. Just paste it in Discord etc.
arnestyles.gui.preset_bad_code: The clipboard has no valid preset code (starts with ARNE1:)
arnestyles.mod.zoom.desc: Hold the key to zoom (default: C, change it in the controls settings)
arnestyles.mod.zoom_level.desc: How far you zoom when you press the key
arnestyles.mod.zoom_smooth.desc: Glides in and out instead of jumping
arnestyles.mod.zoom_scroll.desc: While zooming, scroll to zoom in or out (1.5x to 50x)
arnestyles.mod.zoom_slow_mouse.desc: The mouse adapts to the zoom so you can aim precisely
arnestyles.mod.freelook.desc: Hold the key (default: left Alt): look around while you keep walking straight. Not allowed on some servers.
arnestyles.mod.freelook_third_person.des: Switch to the back view while using freelook
arnestyles.mod.auto_gg.desc: Writes "gg" in chat when a player you just hit dies (at most every 5 seconds)
arnestyles.customize.preview_texture: The selected texture, large, with your color. Click to draw
arnestyles.customize.mode.simple.desc: Simple: one tile per texture, the color applies to all states. Click for advanced.
arnestyles.customize.mode.advanced.desc: Advanced: every state on its own (e.g. anchor charges 0 to 4). Click for simple.
arnestyles.mod.group.hud.desc: HUD editor, keystrokes, CPS, FPS, ping, armor, effects, AppleSkin. Left click to expand/collapse.
arnestyles.mod.group.pvp.desc: Hit color, crystal, kill effects, pop sound, hitboxes, pop chams, shield. Left click to expand/collapse.
arnestyles.mod.group.visuals.desc: Block outline, sky, item physics, motion blur, inventory size. Left click to expand/collapse.
arnestyles.mod.group.comfort.desc: Zoom, freelook, auto GG, chat, fullscreen. Left click to expand/collapse.
arnestyles.mod.totem_pop_sound.play: Click to listen (%s of %s). Switch with < and >.
arnestyles.layout.info: Click a template or change each option on the right. Standard = normal ArneTweaks look.
arnestyles.layout.small: Make the menu smaller (size above) to get more room for the options.
arnestyles.layout.corners.desc: How round buttons, cards and windows are.
arnestyles.layout.header.desc: Top bar with a gradient or a single color.
arnestyles.layout.sidebar.desc: Icons only: narrow bar, more room on the right. Hover to see names. Typing still searches.
arnestyles.layout.active.desc: How the selected entry (e.g. in the sidebar) is highlighted.
arnestyles.layout.buttons.desc: Minecraft: buttons with a light and dark edge like the normal game menu.
arnestyles.layout.switches.desc: How on/off is shown: slide switch, ON/OFF text or a checkbox.
arnestyles.layout.mods_view.desc: Mods page: expandable categories, tabs, tiles or dashboard (blocks in columns with reset).
arnestyles.layout.glass.desc: The menu becomes half transparent, the world shows through.
arnestyles.layout.template.glass.desc: Soft and modern: very round corners, bar on the active entry, half transparent.
arnestyles.layout.template.compact.desc: Narrow icon bar on the left, mods as tabs. Lots of room for settings.
arnestyles.layout.template.tiles.desc: Normal colors, mods as clickable tiles.
arnestyles.layout.template.ocean.desc: Turquoise, flat header, mods as tabs.
arnestyles.layout.template.fire.desc: Red/black PvP look: square, bar on the active entry, ON/OFF as text.
arnestyles.layout.template.mint.desc: Light and friendly: very round, mods as tiles.
arnestyles.layout.template.gold.desc: Black/gold: square, outline, checkboxes instead of switches.
arnestyles.layout.template.sakura.desc: Pink/purple, very round, tiles, half transparent.
arnestyles.layout.template.minecraft.des: Like a vanilla menu: gray 3D buttons, square, ON/OFF text.
arnestyles.mod.hitboxes.desc: Better hitboxes for PvP, shown with F3+B. Helps with timing and judging reach.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_target_color.desc: The hitbox you are aiming at gets its own color.
Color of the hitbox you aim at.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_hurt_color.desc: Right after a hit the hitbox gets its own color (shows when the enemy can take damage again).
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_hurt_color_pick.de: Hitbox color right after a hit.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_eyes.desc: Show a line at eye height.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_eye_color_pick.des: Color of the eye height line.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_look.desc: Shows where the player or mob is looking.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_look_arrow.desc: Arrow instead of a plain line for the look direction.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_width.desc: How thick hitbox lines are for close enemies.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_far_width.desc: How thick lines are for enemies beyond the far distance.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_far_distance.desc: From this distance the far width is used.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_outline.desc: Thicker line behind the hitbox so it stands out.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_outline_size.desc: How much thicker the outline is than the hitbox.
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_hide_fireworks.des: No hitboxes for firework rockets (e.g. elytra flying).
arnestyles.mod.hitbox_hide_items.desc: No hitboxes for items on the ground.
arnestyles.mod.hide_stuck_arrows.desc: Arrows and bee stingers stuck in players are not shown.
arnestyles.keys.info: Save your whole key layout as a set, load it or share it as a code. Type a name + Save.
arnestyles.keys.reset_done: All keys are back to default.
arnestyles.gui.performance_hint: 19 light packs for weak PCs. Other styles apply on top.
arnestyles.performance.view_distance.des: How many chunks are rendered. Lower = much more FPS. Right-click: back to 12.
arnestyles.performance.particles_minimal: Only shows the most important particles.
arnestyles.performance.no_shadows.desc: No round shadows under players, mobs and items.
arnestyles.performance.no_smooth_light.d: Turns off smooth lighting (ambient occlusion). Chunks build faster.
arnestyles.performance.fast_leaves.desc: Draws leaves opaque. Gives a lot of FPS in forests.
arnestyles.performance.less_effects.desc: No smoke and no explosion particles (like the Essentials). Helps in Crystal PvP.
arnestyles.gui.performance_settings_hint: Pick a profile or tune each setting. Applies instantly.
arnestyles.performance.profile.potato.de: Maximum FPS: all switches on, render distance 6, entities 50%, no FPS limit.
Good FPS and still looks normal: render distance 10, fast clouds, fewer particles.
arnestyles.performance.profile.pretty.de: Everything pretty (Minecraft default), render distance 16. For strong PCs.
arnestyles.performance.simulation_distan: How far the world around you is alive (mobs, redstone, plants). Singleplayer only. Right-click: 12.
arnestyles.performance.entity_distance.d: How far away players, mobs and items are drawn. Lower = more FPS. Right-click: 100%.
arnestyles.performance.fps_limit.desc: Highest FPS. Far right = unlimited. Right-click: 120.
arnestyles.performance.vsync_off.desc: Do not lock FPS to the monitor refresh rate. More FPS and less input delay.
arnestyles.performance.no_mipmaps.desc: No blurred textures in the distance. Saves video memory (reloads briefly).
arnestyles.performance.no_biome_blend.de: Do not blend grass and water colors between biomes. Chunks load faster.
arnestyles.performance.no_chunk_fade.des: New chunks appear instantly instead of fading in.
arnestyles.performance.no_menu_blur.desc: No blurred background in menus (inventory, pause).
arnestyles.performance.less_weather.desc: Only draw rain and snow very close to you.
arnestyles.draw.title: Draw your own
arnestyles.draw.hint: Left: draw · Right: erase · Ctrl+Z: undo
arnestyles.draw.name: Name your drawing …
arnestyles.draw.need_name: Give your drawing a name first
arnestyles.draw.too_big: Too big to draw (%sx%s, at most %s pixels wide)
arnestyles.customize.rainbow.desc: The color cycles through all colors (items, blocks and HUD). Speed: 3 seconds per loop
arnestyles.mod.hand_editor.desc: Position, rotation and size per held item, edited live
arnestyles.hand.title: Hand editor
arnestyles.export.row: Export current setup as a resource pack
arnestyles.theme.seasonal.desc: Christmas in December, Easter around Easter, Halloween from mid October. Your own design stays saved
arnestyles.paint.no_block: Look at a block and press the key again.
arnestyles.paint.no_texture: This block side has no Minecraft texture that can be painted.
arnestyles.mod.chat_timestamps.desc: Shows the time before every chat message, e.g. [14:32]
arnestyles.mod.chat_stack.desc: The same message several times in a row is shown once with (x2), (x3) …
arnestyles.mod.death_point.desc: On death your position goes to chat, then the HUD shows distance and direction (15 minutes)
arnestyles.mod.toggle_sprint.desc: Press the sprint key once instead of holding it (Minecraft option, quicker to reach here)
arnestyles.mod.toggle_sneak.desc: Press the sneak key once instead of holding it (Minecraft option, quicker to reach here)
arnestyles.mod.hide_own_effect_particles: Your own potion effect swirls no longer appear as colored blobs in front of the camera (other players still show theirs)
arnestyles.mod.group.sounds.desc: Own volume for hits, crystals, pearls, eating and more. Left click to expand/collapse.
arnestyles.mod.crosshair_target.desc: The crosshair changes color when you aim at a living entity in reach
arnestyles.mod.crosshair_target_color.de: Crosshair color when an enemy is in reach
arnestyles.sound_mixer.xp.desc: XP pickup, level up, XP bottles
arnestyles.mod.waypoints.desc: Set a waypoint with /arnetweaks waypoint add or your own key (Controls, unbound by default). The HUD shows the nearest three with distance and direction. /arnetweaks waypoint add|remove|list|clear
arnestyles.waypoint.none: No waypoints here yet (/arnetweaks waypoint add)
arnestyles.waypoint.cleared: Removed all waypoints in this world and dimension
arnestyles.mod.hit_crits.desc: Every hit shows crit particles (only on your screen)
arnestyles.mod.hit_sharpness.desc: Every hit shows blue sharpness particles (only on your screen)
arnestyles.mod.hit_particles.desc: How many particles per hit (1x to 5x)
arnestyles.mod.totem_pop_style.desc: How the totem flies across the screen
arnestyles.mod.totem_particle_color.desc: Totem particle color: Minecraft, rainbow or a fixed color
arnestyles.mod.spotify_hud.desc: Shows song, artist, cover and exact time from Spotify (Windows). No login, fully local via the Windows media controls.
arnestyles.mod.spotify_mode.desc: Song only, song and artist, with lyric line, big lyrics or as a card
arnestyles.mod.spotify_lyrics.desc: Loads lyrics from lrclib.net. Artist and song title are sent to lrclib.net for this. Timing is estimated: pause is detected, seeking is not.
arnestyles.mod.spotify_offset.desc: Show lyrics earlier (minus) or later (plus) if they don't match exactly
arnestyles.mod.spotify_hide_paused.desc: Hides the display while Spotify is paused
arnestyles.mod.customhud_editor.desc: Build your own text HUDs with variables (CustomHud by Minenash, included in ArneTweaks)
arnestyles.mod.customhud_folder.desc: Opens the folder with the CustomHud profiles as text files
arnestyles.inspector.mod_hint: Hover over a mod to see its preview, status and description here.
arnestyles.inspector.page_hint: This page has no preview. Use THEMES to change how the menu looks.
arnestyles.layout.inspector.desc: Right column with a big live preview of the card or mod under the mouse.
arnestyles.layout.size.desc: Large uses more of the screen: more cards side by side.
arnestyles.layout.template.arne.desc: The default design: dark navy, cyan and violet, large window with live preview.
arnestyles.theme.slot.accent2.desc: Selection for textures, drawing and colors
arnestyles.mod.customhud_on.desc: Turns the CustomHud display on or off. Edit profiles in the CustomHud editor.
arnestyles.gui.preset_rename_hint: Type the new name above, then click Rename on the preset.
arnestyles.gui.preset_rename_failed: Could not rename (name empty or already taken)
arnestyles.mod.spotify_cover.desc: Shows the album cover of the song (comes locally from Windows, no internet).
arnestyles.mod.spotify_width.desc: Width of the Spotify display. Scale it bigger or smaller in the HUD editor.
arnestyles.mod.spotify_any_player.desc: Also shows music from other apps (e.g. YouTube in the browser) when Spotify isn't playing.
arnestyles.mod.item_counter.desc: Shows next to the hotbar how many of the selected items you still have in your whole inventory
arnestyles.mod.item_counter_vertical.des: List the items below each other instead of side by side
arnestyles.mod.item_counter_hide_zero.de: Don't show items you have none of
arnestyles.mod.count_totem.desc: Show totems in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_pearl.desc: Show ender pearls in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_crystal.desc: Show end crystals in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_obsidian.desc: Show obsidian in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_anchor.desc: Show respawn anchors in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_glowstone.desc: Show glowstone in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_gapple.desc: Show golden and enchanted golden apples in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_xp.desc: Show bottles o’ enchanting in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_arrow.desc: Show all arrows in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_cobweb.desc: Show cobwebs in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_wind_charge.desc: Show wind charges in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.count_splash.desc: Show splash potions in the item counter
arnestyles.mod.tab_ping.desc: Shows ping as a number instead of bars in the tab list
arnestyles.mod.tab_ping_colors.desc: Good ping green, medium yellow, bad red
arnestyles.mod.custom_crosshair.desc: Draws your crosshair from the crosshair editor instead of the normal one
arnestyles.mod.crosshair_outline.desc: Dark border around the crosshair so it stays visible on bright ground
arnestyles.mod.anim_no_cooldown.desc: The item no longer dips after a hit. Visual only, the cooldown stays the same
arnestyles.mod.anim_eat_bob.desc: Food bobs up and down while eating and drinking
arnestyles.mod.hud_text_shadow.desc: Shadow under the text of all info displays

arnestyles.intro.title: Welcome to ArneTweaks
arnestyles.intro.page0.title: Welcome to ArneTweaks
arnestyles.intro.page0.text: Styles, PvP displays, Spotify, a crosshair editor and much more – and almost everything can be customized. Here are the essentials in 30 seconds.
arnestyles.intro.page1.title: The menu
arnestyles.intro.page1.text: Press %s in game to open ArneTweaks. On the “Mods” page, the search field finds every setting – just type what you are looking for.
arnestyles.intro.page2.title: Styles
arnestyles.intro.page2.text: Crystals, totems, swords, blocks and more: pick a category on the left and click a style. It applies instantly, no texture pack needed.
arnestyles.intro.page3.title: Mods
arnestyles.intro.page3.text: Under “Mods” all features are grouped: HUD, PvP, visuals, sounds and comfort. On the right, the inspector shows a live preview and all sliders.
arnestyles.intro.page4.title: HUD editor
arnestyles.intro.page4.text: Drag every display wherever you want – including hotbar, hearts, scoreboard and boss bar. Scroll = size, right click = reset.
arnestyles.intro.page5.title: Sharing
arnestyles.intro.page5.text: Save your setup under “Presets”. With “Copy my settings as a code” you can send everything to friends – they just paste the code.
